words.def: unable to pay attention because you are thinking about something else.
words.book: I see some of you may have been distracted, but I want to bring your attention back to what we're discussing.
uses: Email
Apologies for the error in the invoice — I was distracted by the site emergency.
Chat
sorry, got distracted by a client call, what did u say? 😅
Meeting
Let's put our phones away so we don't get distracted during the review.
dont: Sorry, my mind was not with you.

words.def: to bring attention back to the main topic or goal.
words.book: Let's refocus on the main point of this presentation.
uses: Email
We need to refocus our efforts on renewing the expiring maintenance contracts.
Chat
guys let's refocus, the client is waiting for the BOQ
Meeting
Let's refocus on the main issue: the site's backup time.
dont: Let's concentrate again on the main subject.
doo: Let's refocus on the main point.

words.def: extremely important because other things depend on it.
words.book: I appreciate your attention so far, and I want to make sure we don't miss this crucial information.
uses: Email
Regular battery testing is crucial for avoiding unexpected UPS failures.
Chat
the delivery date is crucial for this client, pls don't miss it
Meeting
Payment on time is crucial to keep the project moving.
dont: This point is very very important.

words.def: something you have promised to do or have already planned, which takes your time.
words.book: I know some of you may have other commitments, so please feel free to leave at any time.
uses: Email
Due to prior commitments, I can only join the site visit after 2 p.m.
Chat
sorry, I have another commitment at 4, can we move the call?
Meeting
Our commitment is a four-hour response time for all critical sites.

words.def: an explanation that makes something easier to understand.
words.book: I'm happy to go back and provide more details if anyone needs further clarification.
uses: Email
Could you please provide clarification on the payment terms in clause 4?
Chat
need a quick clarification: is the price incl. VAT?
Meeting
Just for clarification, the warranty covers the batteries for two years only.
dont: I need an explaining for this point.
doo: I need some clarification on this point.

words.def: a polite way to tell someone they are welcome to do something.
words.book: I understand that we all have busy schedules, so please don't hesitate to leave if you need to.
uses: Email
Please don't hesitate to contact me if you need any further information.
Chat
don't hesitate to ping me if the inverter acts up again
Meeting
If you have any concerns about the contract, don't hesitate to raise them.
dont: Don't be shy to call me.
doo: Please don't hesitate to call me.

upgrade.plain: The first thing we will speak about is the batteries.
pro: The first thing we speak in it is batteries.
Let's begin by looking at our first main point, which is battery life.
upgrade.why: افتح أول نقطة بـ ‎Let's begin by looking at …‎

upgrade.plain: Now we go to another subject.
pro: Now, I'd like to talk about our maintenance plans.
Now we go to other subject.
We will change the subject now.
upgrade.why: انتقل بسلاسة: ‎Now, I'd like to talk about …‎

upgrade.plain: Like I said before, the warranty is two years.
upgrade.ar: زي ما قلت قبل كده، الضمان سنتين
pro: Like I told before, the warranty is two years.
Same as I said, warranty two years.
As I mentioned earlier, the warranty is two years.
upgrade.why: ‎As I mentioned earlier‎ أرقى من ‎Like I said before‎.

pro: I'd like to draw your attention to the screen.
Give your eyes to the screen.
upgrade.why: ‎draw your attention to‎ طريقة مهنية تلفت بيها النظر.

upgrade.plain: If anyone wants to go out, go.
pro: If anyone needs to step out, please feel free to do so.
Who wants to go out, go.
Anyone can go outside if he want.
upgrade.why: ‎step out‎ = يخرج شوية، و‎feel free‎ بتخليها مؤدبة.

pro: Please let me know if anything is unclear.
upgrade.why: ‎Did you understand?‎ ممكن تبان إهانة؛ قول ‎let me know if anything is unclear‎.
